conviction_note: Baseline median reaction is 5.35% with only 2 of 7 prints up and the last three at -3.6%, -0.1% and -24.8%, so the base rate is poor; I take a small positive because the founder-CEO's monthly Rule 144 selling cadence stopped dead in February and has not resumed in the seven months into this fiscal-year-end print, and because the company has put out an unusual run of AI-knowledge proof points in July and August that no aggregator has connected to the ARR disclosure this release carries.

findings.finding: Insider selling stopped completely seven months before the print: Form 144 / Form 4 pairs were filed on a monthly cadence through the prior winter (144s on 2025-11-03, 2025-12-01, 2025-12-04, 2026-01-02, 2026-02-02, with matching Form 4s on 2025-11-05, 2025-12-03, 2025-12-08, 2026-01-06, 2026-02-04) and then there is not a single Form 4, Form 144 or 8-K of any kind after 2026-05-14 in the entire 400-day index.
findings.corpus_ref: filings.json - the full filing list for CIK 0001066194; last insider filing 2026-02-04, last filing of any kind 2026-05-14
findings.why_not_priced: A stopped 10b5-1 programme leaves no trace anywhere except as an absence in the EDGAR index, and nothing aggregates absences. The stock fell 54% from its 52-week high across exactly the window in which the selling stopped, so if the market had read the halt as a signal it would not still be 16% off its low. The honest alternative reading is that the plan simply expired, which is why I keep this modest.
findings.independence: The 2026-05-23 corpus item records the company's own guidance pointing to 'surging profitability, improved net income, and potential for renewed share buybacks as cash generation exceeds expectations' with $80.5m of cash and no debt - a buyback and a halted insider sale programme are consistent, and that is a different source: https://seekingalpha.com/article/4908218?gt=dc12131794f76e4c

findings.finding: Between 2026-06-25 and 2026-08-16 the company put out an unbroken run of AI-knowledge proof points - a new AI agent for Zoom Contact Center (06-25), a joint Deloitte report on the '$9 trillion knowledge crisis' (06-22), Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader status for customer service knowledge management (07-21), a named enterprise win at Unigarant (08-11), two Stevie Awards (08-12/13) and a company statement on AI knowledge ARR (08-16) - into a fiscal-year-end print at which the AI Knowledge Hub ARR mix is the disclosed metric.

findings.why_not_priced: Six company releases in eight weeks and the observable market response is nil - the same corpus records participants writing '7% revenue growth for a company selling AI agents is terrible' and 'growth here absolutely sucks'. The market is valuing the consolidated growth rate and ignoring the mix shift, and at a $185m market cap with $80.5m of cash there is no sell-side preview in this capture (n_queries=0 in all sweeps) to reconcile the two. Gartner MQ Leader status in the category is the kind of datapoint that changes an enterprise sales cycle and gets no price at all in a microcap.
findings.independence: The 2026-08-16 ARR statement is a separate company release from the Gartner recognition on 2026-07-21 and the Unigarant win on 2026-08-11 - https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/unigarant-selects-egain-modernize-knowledge-141200508.html - but all three reach me through the same captured Stocktwits body, so treat this as one source cluster.
